source_experiment.attacker_view: actual received full models; received same-sender/same-round chunks completed with receiver model frozen at first delivery; known sender IDs
source_experiment.membership: assigned to target training partition (not a sampled-example trace)
source_experiment.threshold: loss < independent class-matched nonmember calibration quantile
source_experiment.aggregation: equal-weight observed attacker/target pairs within seeds; mean and sample SD across seeds; unobserved pairs excluded
source_experiment.heldout_use: test split is divided into calibration and evaluation pools; no attack/utility tuning

cohorts: identical target members; class-matched versus global-distribution held-out nonmembers
diagnostics: 10% and 50% nonmember-calibrated thresholds; oracle best evaluation threshold and oracle label-prior AUC are not deployable attack results
standalone: same initialization, target partition, per-round task seeds, SGD steps and optimizer; no model mixing
